checks.detail: Engine authority advances while Project Format 2/schema 29 remain frozen.
Lifecycle and standard API source become native editable blocks.
Unsupported structured and top-level Rhai remains visible in bounded Code blocks.
Blocks generate linked, marker-stable Rhai without losing custom source.
Automation permissions are explicit and unknown authority fails closed.
Automation publishes and enforces fixed command, source and time ceilings.
Unknown WASM imports are denied and requested permissions are not implicit grants.
Unexecuted/unloaded plugins expose no orphan contribution UI.
Both Save paths ensure and synchronize their companion automatically.
Scratch-inspired categories, direct block mode and advanced Nodes mode are connected.
Automation preview/apply supports one-step commit, cancellation and rollback.
Selection, asset and build contexts host approved live plugin contributions.
Blocks and Automation surfaces are explicit in English, German and Chinese.
Roadmap checkpoint, safety boundary and user workflow are documented.
